remarks: Welcome to this fantastic 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home nestled at the end of a peaceful cul-de-sac on a spacious corner lot in Stamford. Bring your design vision and make this charming house your dream home! Inside, you'll find an open-floor plan featuring a large living room and kitchen, perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. The main level also offers a cozy family room, and two bedrooms complete with a full bath. Head upstairs to discover two additional bedrooms and another full bath, providing plenty of space for everyone. Step outside, and you'll find a generous yard, just waiting for you to transform it into your personal oasis. Whether it's gardening, playing, or lounging, there's room for it all! Convenient access to major highways, downtown, shopping, and dining make this location a hit. Plus, this property is being sold "AS IS," including the pool and shed, giving you even more opportunities to customize and enhance to your liking. Come explore the potential and see how you can make this home uniquely yours!
